name: EvidenceCollectionAgent
description: Packages the Playwright Executor's recordings into one evidence bundle per test, linked to its BRD acceptance criterion: inputs sent (synthetic data flagged), observed output (new page text, messages, chat reply, HTTP response, downloaded documents opened and read for text/headings/tables/pages), every artifact with sha256, API/console observations, and a completeness check; writes an evidence manifest. No verdicts.

inputs.name: test_cases
inputs.description: Test input and expected behaviour per bundle

outputs.name: evidence_collection
outputs.description: status, counts, by_criterion, manifest, bundles[{bundle_id, test_code, criterion_code, criterion_statement, execution_status, inputs, observed{ui_output, messages, reply, documents, http_response}, expectations, artifacts, observations, completeness, digest}]
